title: Staff Shift Swap Checklist
subtitle: Capture original shift, replacement, role qualification, and coverage; confirm manager approval and timekeeping.
description: Staff Shift Swap records original shift, replacement, role qualification, coverage, manager approval, and timekeeping. Staff Shift Swap evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this staff shift swap stage-gated verification when staff must document original shift and replacement. Reconcile role qualification, coverage, manager approval, and timekeeping before the staff shift swap handoff. Use the published schedule, swap request, role qualification record, coverage check, overtime calculation, manager approval, scheduling-system update, timecard, and team notice. Ask the assigned staff shift swap reviewer to confirm original shift against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Staff Shift Swap starting details review
sections.guidance: Match original and replacement shifts, employee roles and qualifications, coverage gaps, overtime impact, manager approval, schedule update, timekeeping, and team notice.

blocks.label: Staff Shift Swap people and reference

sections.title: Staff Shift Swap checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current staff shift swap facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Staff Shift Swap required checks
items: Original shift is identified for this record
Replacement matches the current request or source
Role qualification is ready for point-of-use staff
Coverage limits or questions are resolved
Manager approval is communicated to the responsible person
A changed staff shift swap fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Staff Shift Swap failed or pending items

sections.title: Staff Shift Swap decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold staff shift swap readiness on any failed or pending item.
